mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 10% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS QoQ > GDPC1 QoQ and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
